reference_method: PDF text-layer-assisted full-page transcription on the two balance-sheet pages; every line was visually checked against the rendered scans. The income statement remains manually transcribed and officially corroborated. The seven income-statement anchor rows also have single-reviewer raster-derived cell boxes, independently located from the rendered image without PDF text-layer assistance.
protocol: Copy each selected region from its source PDF page, rasterize it at 216 DPI to remove any embedded OCR text layer, then run the existing DocumentProcessor PDF upload path (PyMuPDF/Tesseract fallback) with separate page-text and numeric-table render scales. Score manually transcribed text and reviewed financial row/value anchors.
limitations: Production-parser OCR path only. This supplemental set contains pages from one third-party Vietnamese scan packet and manually reviewed financial anchors; it is diagnostic, not representative model-selection evidence or safe automatic financial publication. The selected regions include 34 explicit cell-box labels, with 33 meeting PDF-point bounding-box IoU >= 0.3; labels are limited to reviewed anchors and are not a multi-annotator gold standard. There is no paired OCR-engine comparison. Throughput includes parser/OCR invocation but excludes application embedding and database persistence.
